scientific.integrity: The proof independently establishes the center reduction by Steiner symmetrization, alternating orthogonal projections, compactness, and inclusion. The coordinate checker is used only for finite parity and area sanity checks, not as proof of the universal theorem.
limitations: The centering theorem is proved only in the Euclidean plane.
No higher-dimensional reflection-hyperplane analogue is claimed.
Historical originality has a residual risk because the 1928 Estermann note and 1963 Grünbaum survey were not fully searchable in lawful full text.

title: Exact Estermann measure of every regular polygon
